What is the area, in square inches, of a rectangle with a length of $7$ inches and a width of $6$ inches?
A. $13$
B. $20$
C. $42$
D. $84$

The side length of a square is $55$ centimeters (cm). What is the area, in $\text{cm}^2$, of the square?
A. $110$
B. $220$
C. $3{,}025$
D. $12{,}100$

Triangle R has an area of $80$ square centimeters ($\text{cm}^2$). Square S has side lengths of $4$ cm. What is the total area of triangle R and square S, in $\text{cm}^2$?
A. $42$
B. $44$
C. $84$
D. $96$

[Figure: Two similar triangles $JKL$ and $RST$ with right angles at $L$ and $T$ respectively.]

Note: Figure not drawn to scale.

A. $324$
B. $540$
C. $2{,}916$
D. $8{,}100$

The area of a square is $64$ square inches. What is the side length, in inches, of this square?
A. $8$
B. $16$
C. $64$
D. $128$
A right rectangular prism has a length of $11$ meters, a width of $8$ meters, and a height of $10$ meters. What is the volume, in cubic meters, of the prism?

A rectangle has an area of $63$ square meters and a length of $9$ meters. What is the width, in meters, of the rectangle?
A. $7$
B. $54$
C. $81$
D. $567$

The perimeter of triangle $ABC$ is $17$ inches, the length of side $\overline{AB}$ is $4$ inches, and the length of side $\overline{AC}$ is $7$ inches. What is the length, in inches, of side $\overline{BC}$?
A. $4$
B. $6$
C. $7$
D. $11$

A rectangle has a length of $3$ units and a width of $39$ units. Which expression gives the area, in square units, of this rectangle?
A. $2(3 + 39)$
B. $2(3 \cdot 39)$
C. $3 + 39$
D. $3 \cdot 39$

| | Perimeter |

| Triangle $XYZ$ | $150$ |

What is the length of $\overline{XY}$?
A. $2$
B. $6$
C. $18$
D. $56$

A. $92$
B. $84$
C. $80$
D. $52$

Triangle $ABC$ and triangle $DEF$ are similar triangles, where $\overline{AB}$ and $\overline{DE}$ are corresponding sides. If $DE = 2AB$ and the perimeter of triangle $ABC$ is $20$, what is the perimeter of triangle $DEF$?
A. $10$
B. $40$
C. $80$
D. $120$

A. $2$
B. $8$
C. $10$
D. $24$

A rectangle has a length of $13$ and a width of $6$. What is the perimeter of the rectangle?
A. $12$
B. $26$
C. $38$

C. $144$

A. $20$
B. $25$
C. $50$
D. $100$

The glass pictured above can hold a maximum volume of $473$ cubic centimeters, which is approximately $16$ fluid ounces. What is the value of $k$, in centimeters?
A. $2.52$
B. $7.67$
C. $7.79$
D. $10.11$

B. $1{,}568$
C. $3{,}136$
D. $6{,}272$

If $110$ $\text{cm}^3$ of syrup is needed to fill the can to the top, which of the following is closest to the total volume of the pieces of fruit in the can?
A. $7.5$ $\text{cm}^3$
B. $185$ $\text{cm}^3$
C. $640$ $\text{cm}^3$
D. $750$ $\text{cm}^3$

A right circular cylinder has a volume of $432$ cubic centimeters. The area of the base of the cylinder is $24$ square centimeters. What is the height, in centimeters, of the cylinder?
A. $18$
B. $24$
C. $216$
D. $10{,}368$

C. $726\pi$
D. $2{,}904\pi$

B. $2 \cdot 94 \cdot 94$
C. $4 \cdot 94$
D. $94 \cdot 94$

B. $350$
C. $175$
